notes.title: Release 1.1.3
notes.content:
If you purchased the game before it went free to play this update is for you! Exclusive cosmetics!

New Cosmetics

 Supporter Crown Hat, a solid gold crown. (For those who purchased the game before it went free to play)
 Supporter Skin, a solid gold spider skin (For those who purchased the game before it went free to play)


Other Changes

 Throwables no longer break on hitting network players
 Input menu now says use G to throw throwables.

notes.title: Release 1.1.2 - Limited Time Christmas Cosmetics, Throwable Cosmetics, and More!
notes.content:
It's late but here are some christmas cosmetics! I'm wanting to ramp up how often I do limited time cosmetics, so I'll be attempting monthly limited edition ones. This update also brings throwable cosmetics, they don't collide with players, but feel free to taunt your friends from above by throwing snowballs at them!

Until December 31st you can purchase a Christmas Tree Hat and a Coal Throwable!


 New Christmas Tree Cosmetic (Available throughout December)
 New Coal Throwable Cosmetic (Avaialble throughout December)
 New Rock Throwable Cosmetic
 New Snow Throwable Cosmetic
 New Ears Cosmetic
 New Prison Cosmetic
 Bug fix where vectors would be incorrectly sent over to other players
 Fixed text scaling in the shop
 Setup automatic shop events, so now certain halloween, christmas, etc event items will automatically appear during given times.

notes.title: Release 1.1.1
notes.content:
I'm planning on having a few updates big and small come out in the next little while.


 Steam Rich Presence in Main Menu
 Steam Rich Presence in Lobby
 3 New Steam Achievements!
 Chat Visibility Options (Useful for streamers) Restrict whos chat messages appear for you.
 Smaller bug fixes

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.3d
notes.content: A technical bug fix patch, should fix problems with platforms glitching after playing for a while (floating point precision) and also tokens should count without getting over 100%.

notes.title: Release 1.0.3c Update - Cosmetics & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
New Cosmetics

 Fart Emote
 Boot Costume
 Talk to the rat in the cozy room for an item ;)


Bug Fixes

 Added collider so you can't go behind cozy room fireplace
 Shop token balance updates properly
 Scroll in shop is faster
 Escape now will back out of settings

notes.title: Release 1.0.3b Update - Halloween is over :(
notes.content:
Changes

 Halloween Items no longer purchasable.


Soon

 Option to enable player collision for yourself
 Toggleable Live Leaderboard
 Currently experimenting with spider tethering.

notes.title: Release 1.0.3 Update - Halloween Cosmetics!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3


 Pumpkin Cosmetic (available until Nov 1st)
 6 Jack-O-Lantern Cosmetics (available until Nov 1st)

notes.title: Release 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Update 1.0.2


 Coyote time added to the grapple hook (5 frames, same as jump)
The entrance and exit to the cozy room are now one way, you can no longer fall back down to the cozy room by accident
Ability to invite people from the steam shift-tab menu

notes.title: Release 1.0.1b Update
notes.content:
Quick hotfix for a bug introduced in 1.0.1

Bug allowed players to collide, it has now been fixed.

notes.title: Release 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
A few small tweaks.


 Option to choose which region to search for a lobby.
 Tweaked a collider in the tower preventing a soft lock
 Markup is now blocked in chat. (Very sadge but had to be done, otherwise you could size 1000 fill someones screen with an emoji)
 Player collider tweaked to prevent getting stuck on edges

notes.title: Release 1.0b Update
notes.content:
Just a small update with some new items and tweaks

Items

 Bone Trail
 Bonk Sound Emote
 Headband Item


Fixes/Tweaks

 Collider fixed on moving platform at Tower entrance
 Messages didn't always fade properly should be fixed
 Chat now closes properly when tabbing out while it's open
 Spider NPC Interact collider changed so you can't talk while under it.
 Settings menu wasn't saving the singleplayer setting. Now fixed.
 Trails now hide when not moving
